issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body: A tiny text adventure in one Python file: two rooms, one item, one way to win. The producer commits short design notes to its own repository; the game developer writes the playable script in its own repository; the producer then takes the build into its own repository and publishes it as a role release for the playtester. The playtester plays the released build and commits a short playtest report to its own repository. Write commit messages that say what each change is for. Keep everything small; a few minutes of work for each position is enough.
